title: lupinus arcticus var. subalpinus
intro: Lupinus arcticus var. subalpinus, commonly known as Arctic Lupine, is a plant species that belongs to the lupine family and is native to the mountainous regions of North America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support the immune system and provide antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Arctic Lupine include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help to soothe and protect the body from infections and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, terpenoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
